blocks.zh: 抛物型方程的极值原理
blocks.label: sec:parabolic-maximum-principles

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We shall consider solutions defined on $\Omega\times(0,T)$, where $\Omega$ is an (open) domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$ (more general regions in $(\bm{x},t)$ space can be considered). We set $D=\Omega\times(0,T]$, $Q=\Omega\times(0,T)$ and $\Sigma=(\partial\Omega\times[0,T])\cup(\Omega\times\{0\})$. We shall assume that the coefficients are continuous on $\overline D$, and that the matrix $a_{ij}$ is strictly positive definite on $\overline D$. Throughout we shall also assume that $u\in C^2(D)\cap C(\overline D)$. The maximum principle for parabolic equations says that (under appropriate sign conditions on $c$ and $f$) the maximum of $u$ must be on $\Sigma$.
blocks.zh: 考虑定义在 $\Omega\times(0,T)$ 上的解, 其中 $\Omega$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中的一个 (开) 区域 (也可以考虑 $(\bm{x},t)$ 空间中更一般的区域). 令 $D=\Omega\times(0,T]$, $Q=\Omega\times(0,T)$, 且 $\Sigma=(\partial\Omega\times[0,T])\cup(\Omega\times\{0\})$. 假设系数在 $\overline D$ 上连续, 且矩阵 $a_{ij}$ 在 $\overline D$ 上严格正定. 还始终假设 $u\in C^2(D)\cap C(\overline D)$. 抛物型方程的最大值原理指出, 在 $c$ 和 $f$ 满足适当符号条件时, $u$ 的最大值必在 $\Sigma$ 上.

blocks.en: The analogue of Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} for parabolic equations is the following result.
blocks.zh: Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} 对抛物型方程的对应结果如下.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $\Omega$ is bounded and $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$). Moreover, let $c(\bm{x},t)=0$ in $D$. Then the maximum (minimum) of $u$ is achieved on $\Sigma$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\Omega$ 有界且 $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$). 再设在 $D$ 内 $c(\bm{x},t)=0$. 那么 $u$ 的最大值 (最小值) 在 $\Sigma$ 上达到.
blocks.label: thm:parabolic-weak-maximum
